title: About Estatify.ai
subtitle: We're on a mission to bring modern AI and behavioral analytics to real estate agencies, helping them work smarter and close more deals.
story: Founded in 2024, Estatify.ai was born out of a simple observation: real estate agencies in Costa del Sol were spending too much time on manual admin work and relying too heavily on generic property portals.
We noticed that the most successful global tech companies use behavioral data to personalize experiences and predict buying intent, yet the real estate industry was left behind.

So, we built Estatify.ai to bridge that gap. We combine deep integrations with local MLS systems like Resales Online with cutting-edge AI and advanced behavioral analytics to give our clients an "unfair advantage" in a highly competitive market.

mission.title: Our Mission
